lines.2: 「Oh, but those whose grades have shown a particularly marked decline will be staying for remedial lessons. I'll call your names now.」
lines.4: 「Today it's the clingy little buddy pair: Mr. Tsushima and Mr. Fukahire.」
lines.6: 「Exactly, ma'am. Please don't just assume we're friends.」
lines.7: 「That's what you're objecting to?! We are friends, aren't we?」
lines.8: 「It just felt unpleasant hearing you say it to my face.」
lines.10: There it is, that weird crying noise of his. (He's faking it, obviously.)
lines.11: 「Incidentally, tomorrow will be the dimwit duo of Miss Kanisawa and the suntanned girl. Look forward to it.」
lines.14: 「No matter how you look at it, the suntanned girl means Mana, yes?」
